name: session-bg
description: Drives per-pane animated terminal backgrounds from live Claude Code / Codex session state.

interface.shortDescription: Live per-pane animated terminal backgrounds driven by session state.
interface.longDescription: Feeds live Claude Code / Codex session state (mode, active tool, subagent count, prompts) into a per-pane control channel that the sbg-fx Tattoy plugin reads to drive an animated terminal background — idle, thinking, running a tool, waiting on a prompt, compacting, and more.
defaultPrompt: Show the current session-bg state for this pane.
Tune the background animation's density, speed, and hue.
